sites.name: Star Tech
sites.note: iPhones sold with BTRC-approved one-year Apple warranty (official); iPads with '1 Year international warranty' (unofficial). Per-storage cash price via the product page's own variation request; struck price used as oldPrice. iPhone 17e and iPhone Duo pages show 'To be announced' (no offer). Used as specsSource.

sites.name: Gadget & Gear
sites.note: Apple authorised reseller, 1-year official + 1-year extended warranty. Cash price = discountedPrice in page data (the SSR text shows the EMI/regular price, recorded as oldPrice). iPhone Duo 'Coming Soon' with no price; several iPads Stock Out.

sites.name: Apple Gadgets
sites.note: Unofficial imports; per-variant price/compare price/status with region options (JP/UAE eSIM, USA eSIM, AUS SIM+eSIM, HK). 'Just Active' (activated) units and nano-texture iPad options excluded. iPhone Duo is pre-order only.

sites.name: Sumash Tech
sites.note: Separate '-official' pages (official) and international pages (region per variant). Official pages carry no discount (price = MRP). iPhone Duo listing only shows a 10,000 booking amount, skipped.

sites.name: Kry International
sites.note: Unofficial pages with region per variant (USA, JAPAN, AUS, GLOBAL, Hong Kong, Singapore, Canada, UK, IND) plus '-official' pages. iPhone Duo listing is a 20,000 booking price, skipped.

sites.name: Executive Machines
sites.note: Apple Authorised Reseller, one page per storage, official warranty; widest official coverage incl. iPhone Duo and 2TB models; iPad mini and some iPad configs not listed.

sites.name: Diamu
sites.note: WooCommerce, unofficial, per-variant region prices. iPhone Duo is pre-order (256GB variant priced same as 1TB, looked like a data error, skipped). iPad mini page out of stock with no variant price.

sites.name: Dazzle
sites.note: Unofficial regional variants (JP/MEA, SG/AUS/TH, USA, HK/CH) in page data; only active, non-TBA variants used. MRP shown is inflated. Some variant data looks wrong (17 Pro Max 2TB cheaper than 1TB) and was skipped. iPhone Duo is a 10,000 booking only; no 17e/16e prices.
